title: ACCOUNTANT
text: Accountant to manage general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, tax returns, reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.

title: ADVOCATE
text: Attorney to provide legal advice, draft contracts, conduct legal research and represent clients in court and litigation.

title: AGRICULTURE
text: Agriculture specialist to manage crop production, farm operations, soil and irrigation, livestock and agronomy programs.

title: APPAREL
text: Apparel merchandiser to manage clothing collections, garment production, fashion trends, fabric sourcing and retail buying.

title: ARTS
text: Arts program coordinator to organize exhibitions, theater and music events, work with artists and manage art education programs.

title: AUTOMOBILE
text: Automotive technician to diagnose and repair vehicles, engines, brakes and transmissions, and perform vehicle maintenance.

title: AVIATION
text: Aviation maintenance technician to inspect and repair aircraft, follow FAA regulations and support flight operations.

title: BANKING
text: Banking officer to open customer accounts, process loans and deposits, ensure compliance and provide branch customer service.

title: BPO
text: BPO call center agent to handle inbound and outbound customer calls, resolve client issues and meet process quality targets.

title: BUSINESS-DEVELOPMENT
text: Business development manager to find new clients, build partnerships, generate leads and grow company revenue.

title: CHEF
text: Chef to prepare dishes, plan menus, manage the kitchen staff, ensure food safety and control food costs.

title: CONSTRUCTION
text: Construction project manager to supervise building sites, contractors, safety, schedules and construction budgets.

title: CONSULTANT
text: Consultant to analyze client business problems, recommend solutions, lead projects and present findings to stakeholders.

title: DESIGNER
text: Designer to create visual concepts, layouts and branding using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.

title: DIGITAL-MEDIA
text: Digital media specialist to manage social media, create video and web content, run online campaigns and analyze engagement.

title: ENGINEERING
text: Engineer to design mechanical and electrical systems, use AutoCAD, perform testing and manage engineering projects.

title: FINANCE
text: Financial analyst to build financial models, forecasts and budgets, analyze investments and prepare financial statements.

title: FITNESS
text: Fitness trainer to lead personal training sessions and group exercise classes, design workout programs and coach clients.

title: HEALTHCARE
text: Healthcare professional to provide patient care, maintain medical records, assist physicians and follow clinical procedures.

title: HR
text: HR specialist to manage recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll, benefits and HR policies.

title: INFORMATION-TECHNOLOGY
text: IT specialist to support networks, servers and help desk, manage systems administration and troubleshoot hardware and software.

title: PUBLIC-RELATIONS
text: Public relations specialist to write press releases, manage media relations, plan events and handle corporate communications.

title: SALES
text: Sales representative to sell products, meet sales targets, manage customer accounts and negotiate deals.

title: TEACHER
text: Teacher to plan lessons, teach students in the classroom, assess student progress and communicate with parents.
